name: py-topo-sort
instruction: Implement topo_sort.py: def topo_sort(graph: dict) -> list. graph maps node -> list of nodes it DEPENDS ON. Return a topological order where every dependency precedes its dependent. Break ties by sorting names alphabetically so the output is DETERMINISTIC. A node that only appears as a dependency (never as a key) is still part of the graph. Raise ValueError('cycle') on any cycle. An empty graph returns [].
gateCmd: python3 -c "from topo_sort import topo_sort as t; assert t({'b':['a'],'a':[]})==['a','b']; print('gate ok')"
verifyCmd:
python3 -c "from topo_sort import topo_sort as t
assert t({})==[]
assert t({'b':['a'],'a':[]})==['a','b']
r=t({'c':['a','b'],'b':['a'],'a':[]})
assert r==['a','b','c'], r
r2=t({'z':[],'y':[],'x':[]})
assert r2==['x','y','z'], r2
r3=t({'app':['lib']})
assert r3==['lib','app'], r3
try:
    t({'a':['b'],'b':['a']}); raise SystemExit('no cycle error')
except ValueError: pass
print('ok')"
